name: net_script_mirror_boss
description: VUH-2252: the host's script calls on a mirrored boss reach the client. Two instances with the player package's shipped defaults on a loopback relay; the host leads to the BC Thresholder fight (05/0B btl72, as in net_route_tt_hb_3p), both Soras fight, and both screens are filmed at the same time for a side-by-side clip. The inject logs' per-second [script-mirror] lines are the message counts: calls the host saw, repeats that cost nothing on the wire, records and packets sent, and what the client applied. Soras are protected (team 0).

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))
[log_count('[script-mirror] configure requested=1', i) for i in range(2)]==[1,1]
steps.message: The script mirror is not on with the shipped defaults

steps.expr: all(any(a.get('objectId')==353 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(2))

log_matches(r'\[script-mirror\] host sec frame=(?P<frame>\d+) calls=(?P<calls>\d+) repeats=(?P<repeats>\d+) replaced=(?P<replaced>\d+) queued=(?P<queued>\d+) packets=(?P<packets>\d+) records=(?P<records>\d+) unmapped=(?P<unmapped>\d+) notMirrored=(?P<notMirrored>\d+) full=(?P<full>\d+) sendFailed=(?P<sendFailed>\d+) pending=(?P<pending>\d+) traps=(?P<traps>\S+)', 0)

log_matches(r'\[script-mirror\] client sec frame=(?P<frame>\d+) received=(?P<received>\d+) applied=(?P<applied>\d+) held=(?P<held>\d+) heldApplied=(?P<heldApplied>\d+) expired=(?P<expired>\d+) refused=(?P<refused>\d+) faults=(?P<faults>\d+) traps=(?P<traps>\S+)', 1)
[log_count('[script-mirror] swap-refused', 0), log_count('[script-mirror] client-refused', 1), log_count('[script-mirror] admission refused', 1)]

steps.message: A script-mirror pin or admission refused (see the inject logs)
A runtime logged a new desync notice during the boss fight
